results.question: How many vehicles are currently available?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'available';
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'available'

results.question: List all branch offices and the city they are in. Show the branch name and city.
results.sql: SELECT name, city FROM locations;
results.gold_sql: SELECT name, city FROM locations

results.question: How many Toyota cars do we own?
results.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles WHERE make = 'Toyota';
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vehicles WHERE make = 'Toyota'

results.question: Which vehicles are currently in maintenance? Show make, model and license plate.
results.sql: SELECT make, model, license_plate FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'maintenance';
results.gold_sql: SELECT make, model, license_plate FROM vehicles WHERE status = 'maintenance'

results.question: Câți clienți sunt înregistrați în total?
results.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM clients;
results.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients

results.question: Show the five most expensive vehicles by daily rate. Show make, model and daily rate.
results.sql:
SELECT make, model, daily_rate
FROM vehicles
ORDER BY daily_rate DESC
LIMIT 5;
results.gold_sql: SELECT make, model, daily_rate FROM vehicles ORDER BY daily_rate DESC LIMIT 5

results.question: What is the average salary of employees per branch?
results.sql: SELECT locations.name, AVG(employees.salary) FROM locations JOIN employees ON locations.id = employees.location_id GROUP BY locations.id, locations.name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT l.name, AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees e JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id GROUP BY l.name

results.question: How many vehicles are there in each category?
results.sql: SELECT vehicle_categories.name, COUNT(vehicles.id) FROM vehicle_categories LEFT JOIN vehicles ON vehicle_categories.id = vehicles.category_id GROUP BY vehicle_categories.name
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS vehicle_count FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_categories c ON v.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

results.question: What is the total revenue from completed payments?
results.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed';
results.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments WHERE status = 'completed'

results.question: Show total revenue by location.
results.sql: SELECT locations.name, SUM(payments.amount) AS total_revenue FROM locations JOIN reservations ON locations.id = reservations.pickup_location JOIN payments ON reservations.id = payments.reservation_id GROUP BY locations.id, locations.name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN reservations r ON p.reservation_id = r.id JOIN locations l ON r.pickup_location = l.id GROUP BY l.name

results.question: What is the average rating for each vehicle category?
results.sql:
SELECT vehicle_categories.name, AVG(reviews.rating)
FROM vehicle_categories
JOIN vehicles ON vehicle_categories.id = vehicles.category_id
JOIN reservations ON vehicles.id = reservations.vehicle_id
JOIN reviews ON reservations.id = reviews.reservation_id
GROUP BY vehicle_categories.name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, AVG(rv.rating) AS avg_rating FROM reviews rv JOIN reservations r ON rv.reservation_id = r.id JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id JOIN vehicle_categories c ON v.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

results.question: Which vehicle categories have more than fifteen vehicles? Show the category name and the count.
results.sql:
SELECT vehicle_categories.name, COUNT(vehicles.id)
FROM vehicle_categories
JOIN vehicles ON vehicle_categories.id = vehicles.category_id
GROUP BY vehicle_categories.name
HAVING COUNT(vehicles.id) > 15;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM vehicles v JOIN vehicle_categories c ON v.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 15

results.question: How much have we spent on maintenance per maintenance type?
results.sql: SELECT maintenance_type, SUM(cost) FROM maintenance_records GROUP BY maintenance_type;
results.gold_sql: SELECT maintenance_type, SUM(cost) AS total FROM maintenance_records GROUP BY maintenance_type

results.question: Care este veniturile totale pe fiecare metodă de plată?
results.sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method;
results.gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, SUM(amount) AS total FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method

results.question: List the reservations picked up in Miami. Show reservation id, pickup date and return date.
results.sql:
SELECT reservations.id, reservations.pickup_date, reservations.return_date
FROM reservations
JOIN locations ON reservations.pickup_location = locations.id
WHERE locations.city = 'Miami'
results.gold_sql: SELECT r.id, r.pickup_date, r.return_date FROM reservations r JOIN locations l ON r.pickup_location = l.id WHERE l.city = 'Miami'

results.question: Show each client's first name, last name and the number of reservations they made, including clients with none.
results.sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.id)
FROM clients c
LEFT JOIN reservations r ON c.id = r.client_id
GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, COUNT(r.id) AS reservations FROM clients c LEFT JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name

results.question: Which employees work at the Downtown Hub? Show first name, last name and role.
results.sql:
SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.role
FROM employees e
JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Downtown Hub';
results.gold_sql: SELECT e.first_name, e.last_name, e.role FROM employees e JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Downtown Hub'

results.question: Which reservations have no payment recorded against them? Show reservation id, pickup date and total cost.
results.sql:
SELECT id, pickup_date, total_cost
FROM reservations
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM payments
    WHERE payments.reservation_id = reservations.id
);
results.gold_sql: SELECT r.id, r.pickup_date, r.total_cost FROM reservations r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.reservation_id = r.id)

results.question: Show all reviews with a rating of 1. Show the rating, the comment, and the make and model of the vehicle.
results.sql:
SELECT r.rating, r.comment, v.make, v.model
FROM reviews r
JOIN reservations res ON r.reservation_id = res.id
JOIN vehicles v ON res.vehicle_id = v.id
WHERE r.rating = 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT rv.rating, rv.comment, v.make, v.model FROM reviews rv JOIN reservations r ON rv.reservation_id = r.id JOIN vehicles v ON r.vehicle_id = v.id WHERE rv.rating = 1

results.question: Which vehicles have a daily rate above the average daily rate? Show make, model and daily rate.
results.gold_sql: SELECT make, model, daily_rate FROM vehicles WHERE daily_rate > (SELECT AVG(daily_rate) FROM vehicles)

results.question: Which clients spent the most money in total? Show the top ten as first name, last name and total spent.
results.sql:
SELECT clients.first_name, clients.last_name, SUM(payments.amount) AS total_spent
FROM clients
JOIN reservations ON clients.id = reservations.client_id
JOIN payments ON reservations.id = payments.reservation_id
GROUP BY clients.id, clients.first_name, clients.last_name
ORDER BY total_spent DESC
LIMIT 10;
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, SUM(r.total_cost) AS spent FROM clients c JOIN reservations r ON r.client_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name ORDER BY spent DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

results.question: Find the branch with the highest total revenue. Show the branch name and its total revenue.
results.sql:
SELECT locations.name, SUM(payments.amount) AS total_revenue
FROM locations
JOIN reservations ON locations.id = reservations.pickup_location
JOIN payments ON reservations.id = payments.reservation_id
WHERE payments.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY locations.id, locations.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;
results.gold_sql: SELECT l.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN reservations r ON p.reservation_id = r.id JOIN locations l ON r.pickup_location = l.id GROUP BY l.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1

results.question: Which vehicles have had more than three maintenance records? Show make, model and license plate.
results.sql:
SELECT vehicles.make, vehicles.model, vehicles.license_plate
FROM vehicles
JOIN maintenance_records ON vehicles.id = maintenance_records.vehicle_id
GROUP BY vehicles.id
HAVING COUNT(maintenance_records.id) > 3
results.gold_sql: SELECT v.make, v.model, v.license_plate FROM vehicles v WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_records m WHERE m.vehicle_id = v.id) > 3

results.question: List clients who have never left a review. Show first and last name.
results.sql:
SELECT first_name, last_name
FROM clients
WHERE id NOT IN (
    SELECT reservations.client_id
    FROM reservations
    JOIN reviews ON reservations.id = reviews.reservation_id
);
results.gold_sql:
SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name FROM clients c WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM reservations r
  JOIN reviews rv ON rv.reservation_id = r.id
  WHERE r.client_id = c.id
)

results.question: For each branch, show the highest paid employee as branch name, first name, last name and salary.
results.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (l.id) l.name AS branch_name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary FROM locations l JOIN employees e ON l.id = e.location_id ORDER BY l.id, e.salary DESC;
results.gold_sql:
SELECT name, first_name, last_name, salary FROM (
  SELECT l.name, e.first_name, e.last_name, e.salary,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.id ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS rn
  FROM employees e JOIN locations l ON e.location_id = l.id
) t WHERE rn = 1

results.question: Show monthly reservation counts for 2024, as the first day of each month and the count.
results.sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_date)::DATE, COUNT(*)
FROM reservations
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM pickup_date) = 2024
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_date)::DATE
ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_date)::DATE;
results.gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', pickup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM reservations WHERE pickup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND pickup_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
